author: Hola
body:
Well, Phoenix disbanded so I'm LFT now... 

About me:
I'm a 14 years old guy from Finland. I'm a chill, and mature guy. Even though I'm 14 I apparently sound 17 or so. I come from OCN, and I've participated in 2 OCN tourneys. My preferred position is rusher, but I can also play midlines. I'm looking for a mature team, because I can't stand immature kids screaming...
If you wish to contact me add me on skype (McLyyris) but include your IGN

Pros:
Rushing
Bowspamming
Leading, I can stay calm and communicate even in stressful situations.
Cannons (If there's tnt :3)
Parkour: Wallrunning, circle jumping, waterdropping etc.
Stealth
Stratting

Cons:
Timezone (Gmt+2)      
Ping (around 300 to avicus)
Defending
Sword (I'm willing to practice though)
